faq.a: The usual causes are a trailing comma after the last item, single quotes instead of double quotes, property names without quotes, comments, or a missing comma or bracket. Each of these gets its own message here, pointing at the exact spot.

faq.q: Why did a long number change?
faq.a: JavaScript, and so most JSON tools, can only store whole numbers exactly up to 9,007,199,254,740,991. Longer numbers, such as some database IDs, get rounded. You’ll see a warning when that happens; keep such IDs as strings.

faq.q: How big a file can it handle?
faq.a: Files of several megabytes format in well under a second. Very large files skip the colors so typing stays quick; the limit for opening a file is 25 MB.
